title: 8x Vanilla World Gen
description: Biomes are eight times the width of vanilla. Noticeably bigger than Large Biomes.
body:
# 8x Vanilla World Gen

Everything is stretched out. Biomes that normally take a minute to cross now take several. Variety is still there, just further away.

## Features
- All 5 climate parameters scaled: temperature, vegetation, continentalness, erosion, and weirdness
- Biomes 8x wider than vanilla, twice the size of Large Biomes
- Normal world type (no presets required)
- Part of the Vanilla World Gen series: 2x · 4x · 8x · 16x · 32x · 64x

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Create a new world (Normal type)
3. Load in. Only affects ungenerated chunks.

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack, no mods, no executables
